name: 12 - API - Find Patient Appointments - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS status_filter,
        $4::BOOLEAN AS include_past,
        LEAST(GREATEST($5::INTEGER, 1), 50) AS result_limit
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS clinic_id,
        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone
    FROM clinics c
    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON c.name = r.clinic_name
    WHERE c.is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY c.id
    LIMIT 1
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS patient_id,
        p.clinic_id,
        p.full_name AS patient_name,
        p.mobile
    FROM patients p
    INNER JOIN clinic_context c
        ON c.clinic_id = p.clinic_id
    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON p.mobile = r.mobile
    WHERE p.is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY p.id
    LIMIT 1
),

filtered_appointments AS (
    SELECT
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.starts_at,
        a.ends_at,
        a.status,
        a.booking_source,
        a.visit_reason,
        a.google_calendar_event_id,

        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        d.specialty,

        s.name AS service_name,

        c.timezone,

        TO_CHAR(
            a.starts_at AT TIME ZONE c.timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD'
        ) AS appointment_date,

        TO_CHAR(
            a.starts_at AT TIME ZONE c.timezone,
            'HH24:MI'
        ) AS start_time,

        TO_CHAR(
            a.ends_at AT TIME ZONE c.timezone,
            'HH24:MI'
        ) AS end_time

    FROM appointments a

    INNER JOIN patient_context p
        ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id

    INNER JOIN clinic_context c
        ON c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = a.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services s
        ON s.id = a.service_id

    CROSS JOIN request_data r

    WHERE (
        r.status_filter = 'all'

        OR (
            r.status_filter = 'active'
            AND a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
        )

        OR a.status = r.status_filter
    )

    AND (
        r.include_past = TRUE
        OR a.ends_at >= NOW()
    )

    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN a.ends_at >= NOW() THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        a.starts_at ASC

    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM request_data
    )
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context)
            THEN FALSE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context)
            THEN FALSE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM filtered_appointments)
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context)
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context)
            THEN 'patient_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM filtered_appointments)
            THEN 'no_appointments_found'
        ELSE 'appointments_found'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context)
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context)
            THEN 'بیماری با این شماره موبایل در کلینیک پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM filtered_appointments)
            THEN 'نوبتی مطابق فیلتر انتخاب‌شده پیدا نشد.'
        ELSE 'نوبت‌های بیمار با موفقیت پیدا شدند.'
    END AS message,

    r.clinic_name,
    r.mobile,
    r.status_filter,
    r.include_past,

    (
        SELECT patient_id
        FROM patient_context
    ) AS patient_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM patient_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM filtered_appointments
    ) AS appointment_count,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'appointment_id', appointment_id,
                    'doctor_name', doctor_name,
                    'specialty', specialty,
                    'service_name', service_name,
                    'appointment_date', appointment_date,
                    'start_time', start_time,
                    'end_time', end_time,
                    'starts_at', starts_at,
                    'ends_at', ends_at,
                    'status', status,
                    'booking_source', booking_source,
                    'visit_reason', visit_reason,
                    'google_calendar_event_id', google_calendar_event_id
                )
                ORDER BY starts_at
            )
            FROM filtered_appointments
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS appointments

FROM request_data r;
